AI Notes.value: Brazilian photographer and director based in NYC, moved to the US around 2010. Early career: housecleaning, Target overnight work, then photography class opened the darkroom. First professional role assisting a wedding photographer, followed by a staff photographer position at Vox (their first ever), then cold-outreach landed commercial clients including Kanye West (career-defining, per her own account). Now operates fully independently: fashion, music, editorial and portrait photography for Beyonce, Billie Eilish, Rosalia, Pharrell (Adweek cover 2022), Off-White, Dior, Stella McCartney, Burberry, W, T Magazine, Vogue, Document Journal. Also experimenting with 19th-century processes (tintypes, ambrotypes) and fine art. Self-describes as director and creative director. Senior / seasoned independent, approx 12-15 years in; grounds Autonomy 4 (fully self-directed, high-profile client list, sets creative vision; not a creative director leading a team so not 5).
